jobs.name: th-upscale-phoneBoost
jobs.prompt:
Upscale and enhance this photograph: raise this phone snapshot to professional camera quality — true detail, clean tonal range, natural depth, no phone over-processing artefacts. Recover true fine detail — eyelashes, hair strands, fabric weave, skin, background texture — from what the picture actually shows; do not invent a different face, expression or object. The same picture, larger, sharper and cleaner.

IDENTITY LOCK: the same photograph of the same person — keep the face, its features and proportions, expression, skin tone, hair, body, pose, clothing and framing exactly; do not slim, age, reshape or restyle anyone. DETAIL LOCK: sharpen and enrich what is there; never repaint, restyle or redesign.
REALISM: a photograph, not a render — true lens optics, natural fabric and hair texture, believable light, no painterly or CGI look.
AVOID: a different person or face, hallucinated details that change the picture, plastic over-smoothed skin, halos, over-sharpened edges, added text, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, extra limbs, warped hands, duplicated people, a changed crop. NO STUDIO GEAR IN THE FRAME: no softboxes, light stands, umbrellas, reflectors, lamps, C-stands, backdrop stands or any photographic equipment may be drawn into the picture — light itself is welcome, the equipment that makes it never is.
TASK GUARD: return exactly one finished photograph and nothing else — no text, no captions, no UI, no watermark; keep the original aspect ratio and resolution feel.
